about: Every refusal the Tauri shell's commands answer with (Q13), as the webview receives it: one row per variant of src-tauri/src/lib.rs's ShellError, two for spawn_failed (with and without a log tail). The shell's test serializes each variant and must equal its row; lib/shell-error.test.ts parses each row and must read its kind, message and log_tail. Add a row with a new variant, on both sides.
